explanation: The Holy Spirit whom Jesus promises will come to guide the disciples, testify about the truth, and remind them of his words.
The feeling of deep grief or pain that the disciples experience at the thought of Jesus leaving them.
The human world as opposed to God's kingdom; often used to refer to the system that stands in opposition to God and does not understand the truth.
The real and true content of God's word, something the Holy Spirit will lead the disciples into full understanding of.
This means being released from the power of sin; Jesus promises that his death will give the disciples freedom for a new life with God.
A person who gives evidence or confirms the truth about something, here specifically referring to the Holy Spirit and the disciples' role in testifying about Christ.
